title: BioMed-QAgent Gold6 Qoder Flash/Max offline output 2x2 analysis
scope: read-only offline analysis of two Qoder export zips; no Host/task control, no runs, no tracked-source changes

disclaimers.not_a_publication: these offline Qoder zips are NOT formal BioMed-QAgent Publications; they did not pass the Publication byte-verified evidence chain
disclaimers.historical_paths: paths like C:\Users\25943\Documents\Qoder\2026-09-02\... and work/raw/** found in chat.md and methods logs are historical Windows paths from the generation environment, not current paths
disclaimers.coverage_is_not_trust: broad data coverage does not equal trustworthiness; every count below is a measurement, not an endorsement
disclaimers.unavailable_metrics: raw payloads, extraction scripts, exact per-claim row filters, and per-figure pixel data are unavailable in the zips and marked unavailable

x1_schema_decomposition.evidence: Flash 22 files decomposed into facts/screening/other-metric/excluded/rejected/figures/papers/supplementary/reference dims; Max 1 flat fact table + 5 registries

x2_identifier_normalization.evidence: Flash: value_nM+pXC recomputed (10682/10682 consistent), 26 canonical variant tokens, InChIKey identity (8852 resolved/1830 name-only); Max: value_nM normalized (6431/6439, 8 documented exceptions), variants as-reported incl. mixed separators

x3_unit_dose_normalization.evidence: Flash 100% potency rows positive nM, non-convertible routed to other-metric/excluded; Max 99.9% + ug.mL-1/pIC50-range rows kept with reliability note

x4_reusable_dimension_tables.evidence: Flash assay/molecule/compound-name/cellline/variant reference tables (1859/3917/2794/31/16 rows); Max: source registry only

x5_manifest_completeness.evidence: Flash rows/cols/bytes 22/22 match but sha1 truncated to 16 hex + self-row sha1 mismatch; Max md5 5/5 full verified

x6_rejection_exclusion_audit.evidence: Flash excluded_records(190)+rejected_candidates(845)+supplementary_unparsed(836); Max decisions embedded in methods log only

y2_provenance_granularity.evidence: Flash: 9849 chembl_activity_id + 587 table_id/row_index + 207 evidence_text + 39 supplement file::sheet; Max: 6285 ChEMBL ids but location_in_source has 11 unique values for 6439 rows, 9 literature rows paragraph-level

y3_manifest_hash_verifiable.evidence: Flash 21/22 sha1 prefix-verified, truncated digest, self-row mismatch; Max 5/5 full md5 match

y4_qc_claims_reproducible.evidence: Flash 16 qc_checks: record_id/value_nM/pXC/mutant-count/cross-source counts reproduced exactly, 5 biology-median claims direction-only (filter undocumented); Max S12 claims (rows/cols/md5/provenance) all reproduced

y5_methods_log_depth.evidence: Flash 57 steps with n_returned/n_kept/evidence_artifact; Max 13 steps with thresholds and decisions

y6_raw_evidence_retained.evidence: neither zip contains raw payloads or scripts; work/raw and raw/ paths are historical Windows paths not present offline

file_counts_note: Flash 22 CSV vs Max 6 CSV file counts are NOT used as a quality verdict; the crosswalk compares field-level equivalents instead

crosswalk.shared: record_id, variant, compound, chembl id, activity type, value_nM, cell line, source db, retrieved date, extraction method, confidence/reliability
crosswalk.flash_only_fields: pXC, cross-source agreement (423 consistent/310 divergent), identity resolution, evidence text, table/row/column coordinates, sem/percent

crosswalk.shared: curve id, figure ref, inhibitors, system

crosswalk.max: egfr_sources.csv (7 per-source rows incl. 2 failed sources documented)
crosswalk.flash_only_fields: per-paper selection route and record counts

crosswalk.flash: chembl_assay_catalog (1859), chembl_molecule_dimension (3917), compound name resolution (2794), cellline genotype (31), variant classification (16), pubchem_assay_inventory (794)

verified_claims: missing value_nM rows are the 8 documented non-convertible ones

chat_md_comparison.scoring_note: chat.md length is NOT scored; only strategy content extracted

flash.strategy: anchor on ChEMBL assay_variant_mutation (11713 mutant activities) + WT comparators restricted to the same 483 documents; EuropePMC multi-query open-access paper selection (23 queries logged); parallel figure catalogue; supplementary serial download with backoff after EBI throttling (10054)
tools_sources: EuropePMC REST search + fullTextXML (8 workers, resumable)
NCBI esearch/esummary PubChem BioAssay (794 AID inventory)
failures_fallbacks: connection reset 10054 under concurrency -> serial retry
figure raster assets not served (520/no OCR) -> no pixel digitization, curves only from numeric tables
PubChem record-level values not exposed from environment -> kept as assay inventory only
self_corrections: unannotated EGFR row misjudged as L858R/T790M -> inference rule fixed
cross-assay curve merge + docx merged-cell duplicates -> regroup/dedupe
flash.self_checks: biological-order QC (osimertinib C797S ~237 vs 1.9 nM spot checks), 16 automated qc_checks, exon19 coverage verification rerun

max.strategy: download all 58847 CHEMBL203 activities (118 pages) then filter (5178 defined-mutant + 1622 notable-drug overlap -> 6285); GtoPdb target 1797 interactions (145 kept); 3 landmark PMC papers full-text (Cross 2014, Floc'h 2018, Baker 2020); honest documentation of blocked routes
failures_fallbacks: PubChem geneid assay endpoint 504x2 then 404 -> excluded with evidence
PMC /bin/ supplements 404, oa.fcgi retired -> documented blocked with exact filenames
AACR tables delivered as figure images -> text regex extraction instead
self_corrections: non-JSON ChEMBL response diagnosed via content-type
QC caught figure-verification column mismatch -> rebuild
edit accidentally dropped supplements block -> re-added
32 GtoPdb rows lacked primary id -> fallback identifier added
max.self_checks: provenance completeness validation, reliability rules in log, final re-parse of all CSVs

chat_md_comparison.shared_limit: neither performed pixel-level digitization of dose-response figures; both record why and where

issues.issue: manifest self-row sha1 mismatch: claimed 389e64b2acd77011 vs actual d57d6e9a4b12efc3... (all other 21 files prefix-match)
issues.impact: manifest not self-consistent; downstream integrity chain has one broken link

issues.count: flash 57 steps reference work/raw/**; max references raw/**
issues.issue: neither zip contains raw payloads, scripts, or paper XML; Flash additionally claims 'reproducible from scripts/' but scripts/ is absent from the zip
issues.impact: provenance closure stops at the output tables; claims of reproducibility are not verifiable offline

issues.issue: sha1 digests truncated to 16 hex chars (64-bit prefix), not full SHA-1
issues.impact: weaker integrity guarantee; collision resistance far below SHA-1

issues.issue: header 'variant_reported' appears twice (103 columns); DictReader-style consumers silently lose one column
99.2% screening rows have no direct paper DOI; paper linkage only via chembl_activity_id -> document join
issues.impact: direct per-row paper traceability weak in this table

issues.issue: reference-biology medians not exactly reproducible from published tables (gefitinib L858R/T790M claimed 845.0 vs recomputed 941.0 nM, n=40; afatinib 6.9 vs 10.0; osimertinib WT 14.335 vs 114.0; lazertinib L858R/T790M n=1). Direction of every claim reproduces; the row filter per claim is undocumented
issues.impact: QC evidence partially unavailable for independent verification

issues.issue: record-level, not cell-level provenance: 6285 rows share one string ('original table/figure number not exposed by ChEMBL curation')
issues.impact: auditor must re-query ChEMBL by activity id; no table/figure/row/column coordinates

issues.count: 8 rows >1e7 nM (max 933,254,000 nM) + 8 rows missing value_nM
issues.issue: extreme values (up to ~933 mM) retained in main table, only flagged reliability=low 'Outside typical range'; 8 non-convertible rows (ug.mL-1, pIC50 ranges, fold) kept with empty value_nM
issues.impact: usable but requires reliability filter before analysis

issues.issue: retry attempts logged as identical rows
manifest does not cover itself (conventional, noted for completeness)
